title: Module-level doc comments use // not //! — invisible to rustdoc
description: keyword.rs, query.rs, submission.rs, and string_enum.rs each have a module-level comment block using // (regular comment) rather than //! (inner doc comment). These do not appear in rustdoc output. Callers reading generated docs see no module-level explanation for these modules. Fix: convert the top-of-file // comment blocks to //! for all modules that lack proper inner doc comments.
